scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names shared,config,agents,api,web "npm run dev --workspace=packages/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/config" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/agents" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/config && npm run build --workspace=packages/agents
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
